baseline_findings.title: Missing access control for user creation
baseline_findings.description: The function `app/controllers/articles.js::program:create` is handling a route that creates new users. However, there is no authentication or authorization check to ensure that only authorized users can create new users.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: No authentication checks (e.g., isLoggedIn, requireAuth) were found on this function or any shown caller. This route is handling user creation, which requires authentication to prevent unauthorized users from creating new accounts.
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Add an authentication check before allowing the creation of a new user. For example, you can use middleware like `requireAuth` to ensure that only authenticated users can access this route.

baseline_findings.title: Missing authentication for user session creation
baseline_findings.description: The route '/users/session' is a public endpoint that handles user login. It does not require any form of authentication or authorization, which makes it vulnerable to unauthorized access.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: No authentication check (e.g., isLoggedIn, requireAuth) was found in the route registration or its callers. The route is a public endpoint for user login and should enforce authentication to prevent unauthorized access.
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Add an authentication middleware to ensure that only authenticated users can access this route. For example, use 'requireAuth' or 'isLoggedIn' middleware before calling 'users.session'.
